impact.text: This breaks the emission distribution policy

precondition_sources.text: At the time notifyRewardAmount() is called, IVoter(voter).totalWeight() returns zero, which can legitimately occur during early protocol operation or when voting weights temporarily drop to zero.

intent_sources.text: Emissions notified to GaugeManager must eventually be allocated to gauges and reach their intended recipients, including when notification occurs while totalWeight is zero.
